note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), entry 109; the original is in English. The soldier is recorded as unknown in the original, and only the alate and the worker are described. The terms “media” and “cubitus” of the original are kept for the corresponding veins. The synonym list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records have been omitted.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale reddish brown, the mid-dorsal spot much paler than the head; antennae and postclypeus pale yellow to light brown; pronotum and abdomen light brown. Head and body sparsely covered with long, fine hairs. Body length about 4.8–6.0 mm. Head subcircular, slightly wider than long, length to the mandibular base 0.94–1.09, maximum width 1.16–1.29 mm. Mid-dorsal spot large, circular, raised, diameter 0.13–0.17 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 subequal to segment 2 and dividing. Postclypeus hairy, swollen, about half as long as wide, length 0.26–0.28, width 0.56–0.60 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin without a median concavity, the posterior margin subcircular, length 0.32–0.42, width 0.64–0.69 mm. Legs with the tibial spur formula 2:2:2, the dorsal spur of the fore tibia indistinct.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown; fontanelle plate or mid-dorsal spot much paler than the head; postclypeus, pronotum and abdominal tergites light brown; antennae, legs and ventral surface pale golden brown; wings transparent. Head and body densely covered with long hairs. Body length with wings 15.0 mm, without wings 8.0–8.4 mm. Head subcircular, width including the eyes greater than the length, width including the eyes 1.39–1.43, length to the mandibular base 0.98–1.05 mm. Fontanelle plate or mid-dorsal spot large, subcircular, raised, diameter 0.17–0.19 mm. Eyes subcircular, maximum diameter 0.34–0.35 mm, 0.07–0.09 mm from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli broadly oval, long diameter 0.18, short diameter 0.11–0.17 mm, their distance from the eye less than their short diameter, that is, 0.09–0.11 mm. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3. Postclypeus swollen, densely covered with long and short hairs, about half as long as wide, length 0.34–0.35, width 0.64–0.68 mm. Pronotum flat, with irregular pale spots; the anterior margin straight, slightly raised and without a median concavity; the posterior margin nearly straight and slightly incurved in the middle; slightly narrower than the head, wider than long, length 0.62–0.68, width 1.18 mm. Legs with the tibial spur formula 3:2:2, the outer spur very small and inconspicuous. Wings transparent with a light brown tinge, covered with fine hairs; fore wing including the wing scales 13.10–14.7, hind wing including the wing scales 11.4–12.0 mm; the media of both wings with 2–3 branches and the cubitus with 11–12 branches.
